svg.title: Failure taxonomy
svg.desc: A block diagram in four rows and four columns. Row Failure type: tag 1 Action, tag 2 Sensor, tag 3 Plan and tag 4 World drift, in amber boxes. Row Signal, under each type: skill returns a failure reason; status field, impossible value or silence; fails a check before it runs; fresh observation differs from the expected state. Row Recovery starts in: under Action, a blue box, behavior tree (retry, fallback); under Sensor, a black box, a check before the value is used; under Plan and World drift, one red box, planner or agent (a new plan). Row New source, on top: two dashed boxes, VLM output with a dashed arrow into Sensor, and LLM output with a dashed arrow into Plan.
